DEV-003.semantic_rule: Return all products with a price greater than 100.
DEV-003.notes: The question does not explicitly request category or sorting.

DEV-009.semantic_rule: Return customers who have placed more than one order.
DEV-009.notes: The order count is useful but is not explicitly requested.

DEV-011.notes: An additional customer_id column should not automatically make the answer incorrect.

DEV-013.semantic_rule: Return products that have never been ordered.
DEV-013.notes: NOT EXISTS and LEFT JOIN IS NULL can be logically equivalent.

DEV-020.semantic_rule: Return customers who purchased at least one Electronics product.
DEV-020.notes: An additional customer_id column should not automatically make the answer incorrect.

DEV-021.semantic_rule: Return every customer and their number of orders in February 2026, including customers with zero orders.
DEV-021.notes: An INNER JOIN with a date filter in WHERE may incorrectly exclude customers with zero February orders.
